text: Program Description: This major has the basic theory of life science and basic theories, basic knowledge and basic skills of biological technology. It can be engaged in scientific research or teaching in scientific research institutions or colleges and universities. It can be used in industry, medicine, food, agriculture, forestry, animal husbandry, fishery, environmental protection, garden and other industries. The Department of administration is a senior expert in biotechnology research, technology development, production management and administration. This major student mainly studies basic theory and basic knowledge of biotechnology. It is subject to scientific thinking and scientific experiment training in basic research and technology development. It has good scientific literacy and basic ability of teaching, research, development and management. Requirement: 1. Grasp the basic theories and basic knowledge of mathematics, physics and chemistry. 2. Master basic theories, basic knowledge and basic experimental skills in basic biology, biochemistry, molecular biology, microbiology, genetic engineering, fermentation engineering and cell engineering, as well as the basic principles and basic methods of biotechnology and its product development. 3. Understand the general principles and knowledge of similar specialties; 4. Be familiar with relevant policies and regulations such as national biotechnology industry policy, intellectual property rights and bio engineering safety regulations. 5. Understand the theoretical frontier, application prospects and latest developments of biotechnology, and the development of biotechnology industry. 6. Master the basic methods of data inquiry, literature retrieval and use of modern information technology to obtain relevant information; have certain experimental design, create experimental conditions, sum up, organize and analyze experimental results, write papers and participate in academic communication. Duration: 5 years
